correctness.rationale: Complete 2^20-mask enumeration is exhaustive for the exactly specified labelled 20-vertex graph. Separate union-find cycle detection and BFS/Euler acyclicity check agree on all 15 nonzero coefficients and trailing zeros. One-vertex extension checks establish inclusion-maximal profile. A backtracking enumeration of every adjacency-preserving bijection establishes Aut(D) size 120; 25 explicit certificates give disjoint complete coverage of all 2,520 optimum masks. Cubic deleted-set identity c=2-e(D[T]) independently checks optimum component counts. All critical computations are replayable from standalone embedded files, with no extrapolation.

value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical extremal example for the 7/10 induced-forest ratio question in planar girth-five graph theory (Kowalik et al., 2010). Unlike a scalar decycling number or an exhibited optimum forest, the exact polynomial classifies every possible labelled induced forest; 25 symmetry classes, exact connected/disconnected optimum counts and full inclusion-maximal spectrum give a motivated structural benchmark for this sharpness example. Finite natural complete classification, not arbitrary subparameter choice; no downstream general theorem claimed.
